title: BrokerOps
description: Request/result bodies for the broker/* operations, and the documents every broker-facing member shares (spec.md §8.7, ADR 0032, ADR 0093). Behind the 'broker' capability: an engine with no broker client answers component-unavailable naming 'broker'.

BrokerDescriptor.title: BrokerDescriptor
BrokerDescriptor.description: Which Pact Broker, and how to reach it. The engine never reads credentials from its environment: a host passes them here, and the engine never repeats them — not in an event, a summary, an error or a log, where the broker is named by its URL with any user information removed.

client.description: HTTP client options: TLS, proxies, timeouts, retries. The same open document the HTTP transport's drive role takes, specified by the component interfaces' http-transport.schema.json ($defs/ClientOptions; component-interfaces spec.md §5.6, ADR 0035), so one configuration reaches the provider and the broker alike.

BrokerAuth.title: BrokerAuth
BrokerAuth.description: Credentials for the broker. 'bearer' takes 'token'; 'basic' takes 'username' and 'password'.

ConsumerVersionSelector.title: ConsumerVersionSelector
ConsumerVersionSelector.description: One consumer version selector, passed to the broker as written: its vocabulary is the broker's (mainBranch, branch, matchingBranch, deployedOrReleased, deployed, released, environment, consumer, tag, latest, fallbackTag, fallbackBranch), and the engine does not interpret it.

PublishContracts.title: PublishContracts
PublishContracts.description: Publish contracts for a consumer version. Each document is a Janus contract or a v1–v4 pact, all for the same consumer, published as the broker's 'pact' specification (ADR 0011 decision 6), or a Janus contract as 'janus' where the broker advertises pb:publish-janus-contracts (ADR 0093 decision 5).

consumer-version.description: The consumer's application version these contracts belong to.

build-url.description: The build that produced the contracts.

contracts.description: Janus contracts or v1–v4 pacts, each the document or its text, read as a file is (ADR 0063).

PublishContractsResult.title: PublishContractsResult
PublishContractsResult.description: The publish has started, in a broker session; its outcome arrives as events on 'stream' (spec.md §9). The terminal event, 'broker/finished', carries the outcome and ends the session.

PublishProviderShape.title: PublishProviderShape
PublishProviderShape.description: Publish one provider shape (subsumption-check spec §2) for a version of the provider it names, through the broker's pb:publish-provider-shape link (ADR 0093). The engine reads the shape before it publishes it.

provider-version.description: The provider's application version this shape belongs to.

build-url.description: The build that produced the shape.

provider-shape.description: A provider shape, the document or its text.

PublishProviderShapeResult.title: PublishProviderShapeResult
PublishProviderShapeResult.description: The publish has started, in a broker session; its outcome arrives on 'stream' (spec.md §9), in the terminal 'broker/finished', which ends the session.

CheckContracts.title: CheckContracts
CheckContracts.description: Check contracts against the shapes their providers published to the broker, returning one subsumption report per contract for the host to decide over (spec.md §8.7, ADR 0093). Exactly one of 'provider-version' and 'provider-branch' is given, and 'provider-version' only when every contract names the same provider.

contracts.description: Janus contracts or v1–v4 pacts, each the document or its text, read as a file is (ADR 0063).

provider-version.description: Check against the shape published for this provider version.

provider-branch.description: Check against the latest shape published on this provider branch.

publish-reports.description: Publish each report to the link the shape's document gives for it, with the contract it is about.

components.description: The project's declared components, as subsumption/check takes them (ADR 0102): loaded before the check starts, and their operators compared as their handshakes declare.

CheckContractsResult.title: CheckContractsResult
CheckContractsResult.description: The check has started, in a broker session; one 'broker/checked' event per contract arrives on 'stream' (spec.md §9), then the terminal 'broker/finished', which ends the session.
